div.div:
LEGEND & LAYERS
• Black solid (2.5 px): primary compass/passage movement (double arrowhead = two-way)
• Blue solid (2.8 px): vertical UPWAR / DOWN shaft (distinct from compass N/S)
• Purple dashed: magic word / special transition · Local markers: yellow = cross-page · orange = transient · red = death
• Optional layer [Parser Aliases / Fast Travel] (hidden by default): non-adjacent keyword shortcuts

text.tspan: • Black solid (2.5 px): primary compass/passage movement (double arrowhead = two-way)
• Blue solid (2.8 px): vertical UPWAR / DOWN shaft (distinct from compass N/S)
• Purple dashed: magic word / special transition · Local markers: yellow = cross-page · orange = transient · red = death
• Optional layer [Parser Aliases / Fast Travel] (hidden by default): non-adjacent keyword shortcuts

div.div:
LOC_BEDQUILT — in BedquiltYou are in Bedquilt, a long east/west passage with holes everywhere.
To explore at random select north, south, up, or down.
EXITS (source precedence order)
1. EAST → LOC_COMPLEX
2. WEST → LOC_SWISSCHEESE
3. SOUTH ✕ msg FUTILE_CRAWL [65%]
4. SLAB → LOC_SLAB
5. UPWAR ✕ msg FUTILE_CRAWL [60%]
6. UPWAR → LOC_SECRET2 [70%]
7. UPWAR → LOC_DUSTY [Ch 10]
8. NORTH ✕ msg FUTILE_CRAWL [50%]
9. NORTH → LOC_LOWROOM [75%]
10. NORTH → LOC_THREEJUNCTION
11. DOWN ✕ msg FUTILE_CRAWL [65%]
12. DOWN → LOC_ANTEROOM [Ch 09]

div.div:
LOC_COMPLEX — at complex junctionYou are at a complex junction. A low hands and knees passage from the
north joins a higher crawl from the east to make a walking passage
going west. There is also a large room above. The air is damp here.
EXITS (source precedence order)
1. UPWAR, CLIMB, ROOM → LOC_DUSTY [Ch 10]
2. WEST, BEDQU → LOC_BEDQUILT
3. NORTH, SHELL → LOC_SHELLROOM [Ch 06]
4. EAST → LOC_ANTEROOM [Ch 09]

div.div:
LOC_SLAB — in Slab RoomYou are in a large low circular chamber whose floor is an immense slab
fallen from the ceiling (Slab Room). East and west there once were
large passages, but they are now filled with boulders. Low small
passages go north and south, and the south one quickly bends west
around the boulders.
EXITS (source precedence order)
1. SOUTH → LOC_WESTEND [Ch 03]
2. UPWAR, CLIMB → LOC_SECRET1
3. NORTH → LOC_BEDQUILT

go west, east, ne, and nw. Part of the room is occupied by a large
bedrock block.

1. NE → LOC_BEDQUILT
2. WEST → LOC_EASTEND [Ch 03]
3. SOUTH ✕ msg FUTILE_CRAWL [80%]
4. CANYO → LOC_TALL
5. EAST → LOC_SOFTROOM [Ch 06]
6. NW ✕ msg FUTILE_CRAWL [50%]
7. ORIEN → LOC_ORIENTAL [Ch 06]
